      About Calm Space

      Free, private and made to help. No ads, no accounts, no tracking. Your settings stay on this device, and it works offline.

      Calm Space is a set of slow, gentle light and sound scenes, plus a few quiet fidgets to press, flick, spin and squish. Pick one, change it until it feels right, and save it as your calm. Then "Calm now" opens it in one tap. It was designed with autistic adults and SEN classrooms in mind, but anyone can use it.

      How it keeps things safe

      • Nothing in the scenes flashes. Light and colour change slowly and smoothly, over several seconds.
      • There are never more than two noticeable changes in brightness a second. That's stricter than the international accessibility guideline for websites.
      • Reds in the scenes are kept soft and muted. (The picture cards use the standard ARASAAC colours.)
      • Brightness is capped, so the screen never turns bright white.
      • Scene sounds start off unless an adult chooses "Gentle sound". They fade in slowly and the volume is limited. Talk cards speak softly in the device's own voice.
      • If your device is set to reduce motion, everything moves more slowly. "Even gentler" slows it down further.

      This is built in for everyone, so there's nothing to switch on. Even so, stop if anything feels uncomfortable.

      Classroom mode

      Open a scene, tap Adjust, then Adult options, then Classroom mode. The controls disappear and the scene stays put, full screen where possible. To leave, an adult presses and holds a top corner of the screen for 3 seconds, then answers the sums. After a cancelled check it waits 15 seconds before the next one. Talk and My day can also be locked from their adult panels ("Lock this screen"), which hides ← Home until an adult unlocks it.

      Safe to explore

      Tapping, swiping or holding anywhere can't break anything. There are no links out of the app, sound and brightness are always capped, and Preferences, routines and cards are behind an adult check: hold a button for 3 seconds, then answer a sum. Changes made with Adjust last until the app is closed; "Save as my calm" keeps one favourite. Hush is for anyone: one tap turns scene sounds and timer voices off or on, and talk cards keep speaking.

      My day & talk

      Picture cards in groups (core words, feelings with a 1 to 5 scale, people, food and drink, places, things to do and your own cards), kept phrases, a quick Yes / No, a Now / Next / Later picture timetable with optional gentle timers, a First / Then board, and three routines (school day, weekend, bedtime). Cards speak softly using the device's own voice. Only an adult can change the timetable or add photo cards. Photos stay on this device.

      Not a medical device

      Calm Space is not a medical device or a treatment, and the talk cards are not a replacement for a full communication aid. It doesn't diagnose, treat or prevent anything. If you have been given advice about screens or light, please follow it.
